allot.subject: Allotment of Securities
allot.text: Vodafone Idea Limited has informed the Exchange regarding allotment of 430 Crore warrants to Suryaja Investments Pte. Ltd. (an Aditya Birla Group entity and a member of the Promoter Group) on a preferential basis.

allot.subject: Outcome of Board Meeting
allot.text: Vodafone Idea Limited has informed the Exchange regarding Issuance of Warrants on Preferential Basis aggregating upto Rs 4,730 Crores to Suryaja Investments Pte. Ltd., Singapore, (an Aditya Birla Group entity and Promoter Group Company)

allot.subject: Allotment of Securities
allot.text: Vodafone Idea Limited has informed the Exchange regarding allotment of 36,95,00,00,000 Equity Shares to Department of Investment and Public Asset Management, Government of India aggregating to Rs. 36950 Crores pursuant to order u/s 62(4) Of Companies Act, 2013

allot.subject: Allotment of Securities
allot.text: Vodafone Idea Limited has informed the Exchange regarding allotment of  1,69,32,18,361 Equity Shares to Promoters of the Company aggregating to Rs. 1909.95 crores, on a preferential basis.

allot.subject: Outcome of Board Meeting
allot.text: Vodafone Idea Limited has informed the Exchange regarding Board meeting held on December 09, 2024 regarding issuance of equity shares on preferential basis aggregating to Rs. 1980 Crores
